description:
Join the IQRA’S Affiliate Program – Earn with Elegance

🌸 Brand Introduction:
IQRA’S is a Canadian-based modest fashion and lifestyle brand, dedicated to celebrating the beauty and strength of Muslim women through elegant, high-quality products. From timeless hijabs and flowing abayas to home essentials infused with cultural charm, IQRA’S empowers women to express their identity with grace and confidence. We blend tradition with modern aesthetics to create pieces that are meaningful, stylish, and modest.

🛍️ Product Description:
Our curated collection includes premium hijabs, abayas, prayer mats, accessories, and modest wear crafted with care. Every piece is thoughtfully designed to meet the everyday needs of modern Muslim women—whether for prayer, work, or celebration. We focus on comfort, quality, and visual elegance, with standout floral prints and seasonal limited editions.

✨ Unique Selling Point (USP):
IQRA’S combines faith, fashion, and function. Our products are not only stylish and modest, but they’re also designed with the values and preferences of Muslim women in mind. Our signature floral collections and soft-touch fabrics are crafted to offer both beauty and practicality, making them perfect for women who want style without compromise.

💸 Payment Terms for Affiliates:
Earn 15% commission on every successful referral with a 30-day cookie window. Payouts are processed monthly via PayPal or direct deposit, with a minimum payout threshold of $50. Real-time tracking and reporting are available through our affiliate dashboard.

📌 Other Information:

  • Free shipping across Canada on orders over $75

  • Global shipping available

  • Regular product launches and seasonal campaigns to boost affiliate earnings

  • Custom banners, product links, and promotional materials provided

  • Dedicated affiliate support team

Ready to share beautiful, meaningful fashion and earn with every referral?
👉 Join the IQRA’S Affiliate Program today and become part of a movement that empowers women around the world — with elegance, modesty, and purpose.
